scope: Independent successEnabled default false alongside existing attention enabled; old settings are not rewritten on read.
Success kind uses fixed content-free body and the same initial/post-settings-await/platform-final preference, revision and background gates.
Disabling one kind under Unknown or Denied permission preserves the other saved choice; it does not bypass real system delivery permission.
Exact in-memory rendererNonce/sequence withdraw command; no persistent delivery ledger.
macOS queued closure and Windows blocking worker own the pending ticket; observer timeout does not free that pending authorization.
Final ticket mutex covers actual FFI/Show call. Native observation/reply callbacks do not reacquire the ticket lock.

withdrawalContract.withdrawn: The exact ticket has not started the native submit call and late admission is prevented.
withdrawalContract.alreadySubmitted: The native submit call has begun; withdrawal is not guaranteed. This is not proof of API acceptance, delivery or display, even if the call later returns false/error.
withdrawalContract.unknown: Cannot prove no dispatch. No success/no-display assertion.
withdrawalContract.capacity: 256 renderer watermarks remain for app-process lifetime; 256 live/recent records; pending tickets never evicted. New renderer is refused at capacity; existing exact withdrawal remains available.
withdrawalContract.concurrency: Higher sequence arrival can conservatively refuse older not-yet-admitted requests. It never retires admitted live lower-sequence tickets. No FIFO IPC guarantee.

evidenceBoundaries: Two original-production decoder/default behavior failures are preserved; the Denied preference issue was identified by static review of the private draft and its final regression test passed, not claimed as an old-installed production failure.
Synchronous callback tests use real DiagnosticStore and controlled execution owners, not the real macOS notification center.
Actual platform Show/FFI entry placement reviewed in source; macOS build/typechecked by Cargo, Windows source not executed/compiled for Windows here.
No application, Agent, real OS permission request, notification delivery, sound or click exercised.
No full-repository pre/post source inventory claimed for this author run; exact eight current source references provided.
Frontend owner invalidation and OS-installed user journey remain separate evidence owned by peers/root.

diagnostics.backendFreeze: Backend reasons serialize directly into reviewed diagnostic export; frontend only sends its own decision plus exact lookup key, so no frontend backend-reason parser broadened.
diagnostics.privacy: Only fixed diagnostic fields; target key and renderer correlation remain private lookup data, never exported.
